name: hedera-safe-swap
description: Gnosis Safe multisig treasury on Hedera: a 2-of-3 owner-quorum module rebalances idle holdings through SaucerSwap, a permissionless price-guarded module backed by live Chainlink/Supra oracles, and Safe proposals (rebalances and owner changes) relayed between owners via HCS.

steps.text: Copy .env.example to .env and fill in your Hedera testnet operator credentials.
Full setup, architecture, and verified testnet transactions are documented in README.md.
